description.text:
The Journey Theme Pack (启程专题包) is a two-card pack that came in three kinds of gift box from 13 June 2025, as more and more players set out on the Scarlet & Violet series and on collecting the Pokémon numbered 001 to 151. Its first card is a Pokémon card already printed in the Scarlet & Violet series or, with luck, a shiny Pokémon holo or shiny Pokémon ex holo. Its second is a basic Energy holo in a new finish or, with luck, a new Art Rare, a Special Art Rare Venusaur ex, Charizard ex, Blastoise ex or Gardevoir ex, a Chien-Pao ex, Ting-Lu ex or Koraidon ex in a new gold finish, or a gold basic Energy.

The Journey Collection Accessory Gift Box (启程收藏周边礼盒) held one pack with a damage-counter case in one of 37 designs of Pokémon and Energy types (26 regular, four hidden and seven super-hidden), a 20-card booster of Eternal Birth, Miracle Journey or Fearless Terastal and a 5-card Collect 151 望 pack. The Journey Battle Accessory Gift Box (启程对战周边礼盒) held one pack with a set of 64 art sleeves in one of 37 designs, two 5-card boosters and a 5-card Collect 151 望 pack. The four Journey Gift Boxes (启程礼盒), for Venusaur, Charizard, Blastoise and Gardevoir, each held six Journey Theme Packs, three 20-card boosters of one kind and three 20-card Collect 151 望 packs, with 64 sleeves, a coin die and a card box in that Pokémon's design and four damage-counter dice.

Its 49 Pokémon cards are numbered out of 49; the shiny holos, Art Rares, shiny ex, Special Art Rares, gold ex and gold Energy are numbered past it, up to 133. The new-finish basic Energy print their type code instead of a number and are listed in Scarlet & Violet Energies.
